European Football Roundup — May 14, 2026

📅 Invalid Date ✍️ Konstantinos Chaldoupis

Thursday brought a feast of football across Europe. Cup finals were settled, a newly crowned champion was humiliated on their own pitch, underdogs made history, and the biggest game of the night — Real Madrid vs Real Oviedo — Here is everything you need to know.

🇪🇸 La Liga — Matchday 36: Real Madrid vs Real Oviedo

La Liga — Matchday 36
FT
Real Madrid2
—
0Real Oviedo

Real Madrid secured a comfortable 2-0 victory over Real Oviedo at the Santiago Bernabéu in their final home match of the La Liga season.

Jude Bellingham opened the scoring in the 34th minute with a trademark late run into the box, calmly slotting home after a clever pass from Federico Valverde. The English midfielder continues to be Madrid's most consistent performer this campaign.

Academy graduate Gonzalo García doubled the lead in the 67th minute, tapping in from close range after a deflected cross fell perfectly at his feet. The 21-year-old impressed on what could be his final appearance for the club before a potential loan move next season.

Veteran defender Dani Carvajal received a standing ovation as he was substituted late in the second half, likely his final appearance at the Bernabéu. The Spanish full-back has announced he will leave the club when his contract expires this summer.

Real Oviedo fought hard but rarely threatened Madrid's defense. The visitors remain in 17th place, just three points above the relegation zone with two matches remaining.

Key stat: Jude Bellingham now has 22 league goals for the season – the highest by a midfielder in Real Madrid's history.

Up next: Madrid travel to Athletic Bilbao on the final matchday, while Oviedo face a must-win game against Getafe to secure their top-flight status.

Swiss Super League: Thun Humiliated 3-8 at Home by Young Boys

Swiss Super League
FT
FC Thun3
—
8Young Boys

Three days after lifting the Swiss Super League title, FC Thun were brought crashing back to earth in the most brutal fashion. Young Boys ran riot at the Stockhorn Arena, putting eight goals past a Thun side that looked completely disorganised from the first whistle.

The damage was already done by half-time — Thun went in 1-5 down after a horrific 45 minutes in which their defensive line was torn apart repeatedly. The second half offered brief hope when Thun pulled it back to 3-5, but Young Boys responded immediately and ran out comfortable winners.

For Thun, this result will sting. The celebrations from the title win were still ringing around Bern when the goals started going in. For Young Boys, it is a statement of intent ahead of their European qualification playoff next month.

  • 💥 12 goals conceded by Young Boys this season
  • 😴 Clearly a title-hangover performance from the champions
  • 📊 Young Boys: 5 goals scored before half-time
  • ⚠️ Thun coach faces serious questions about squad mentality

Belgian Cup Final: Union Saint-Gilloise Lift the Cup in Extra Time

Belgian Cup — Final
AET
Union SG3
—
1Anderlecht

Union Saint-Gilloise are Belgian Cup winners. In a final that had everything — tension, drama, and a comeback — they overcame their fiercest rivals Anderlecht 3-1 after extra time at the King Baudouin Stadium in Brussels.

Anderlecht dominated the first half and took a deserved lead through a clinical finish just before the break. Union came out a different side in the second half — pressing higher, winning second balls, and forcing Anderlecht onto the back foot. The equaliser came on 71 minutes and Union never looked back.

Two goals in extra time sealed it. This is Union's second major trophy of the season whilst they are battling for the Jupiler League title against Club Brugge.They are firmly established as the dominant force in Belgian football — something that would have seemed unthinkable just almost five years ago when they were still in the second tier.

  • 🏆 Union SG become Cup Champions for the fourth time.
  • 😤 Anderlecht's wait for silverware continues into next season
  • 🌟 Man of the Match: Anan Khalaili — tireless in the wings

🇩🇰 DBU Pokalen Final: Midtjylland Deny Copenhagen a Season to Forget

DBU Pokalen — Final
FT
FC Copenhagen0
—
1FC Midtjylland

If Copenhagen's league campaign was a disaster, losing the cup final to Midtjylland is the full stop on one of their worst seasons in recent memory. A single second-half goal from FC Midtjylland was enough to secure the DBU Pokalen and rub salt into the wounds of a Copenhagen side that had nothing left to play for but pride.

Copenhagen created very little all evening. Their top scorer has been out injured since March, and the lack of creativity in the final third has been a recurring theme all season. The atmosphere inside the stadium told its own story — nervous, frustrated, and ultimately deflated.

Midtjylland, meanwhile, were compact, disciplined, and took their chance when it came. They will head into next season's European qualifying rounds with silverware and momentum.

  • ❌ Copenhagen finish the season with zero trophies — first time in 6 years
  • ✅ Midtjylland win their 4th Danish Cup
  • 🔄 Copenhagen's board expected to oversee a major summer rebuild

🇸🇪 Svenska Cupen: Mjällby Complete Stunning Double Over Hammarby

Svenska Cupen
FT
Mjällby2
—
1Hammarby

The story of the Swedish football season. Mjällby AIF — a club from a town of fewer than 10,000 people on the southern coast of Sweden — have now beaten Hammarby twice in a single season, completing an unlikely double over one of the country's most supported clubs.

Hammarby started the game as heavy favourites on their own turf and took the lead in the first half. But Mjällby refused to be intimidated. They equalised through a well-worked set piece and then scored what turned out to be the winner with 20 minutes left — a moment that sent the travelling Mjällby supporters into complete pandemonium.

For Hammarby, the questions will now come thick and fast. Beaten twice by the same unfancied opponent in a season is hard to explain. The board will demand answers from the coaching staff before the summer transfer window opens.
